<p class="hero-lead">I use genomics and computational biology to understand how animal diversity evolves—from the origins of cell types in early animals to hidden biodiversity and microbial partnerships in coral reefs.</p>

<div class="section-intro">
<p class="eyebrow">Research overview</p>
<h2>Answering evolutionary questions with genomic evidence</h2>
<p>My research combines comparative genomics, phylogenomics, and single-cell transcriptomics to investigate how genomes, cells, and symbioses shape animal diversity. I work primarily with cnidarians, such as jellyfish and corals, which offer powerful perspectives on the evolution of animal tissues, regeneration, immunity, and marine biodiversity.</p>
</div>

<div class="research-grid">
<div class="research-card">
<img src="./images/medusa_011.JPG" alt="Polyp colonies and medusae in the Podocoryna life cycle" />
<div class="research-card-body">
<p class="card-kicker">Cell-type evolution</p>
<h3>How did animal cells and tissues evolve?</h3>
<p>At NHGRI, I study the hydrozoan <em>Podocoryna</em> using genome resources and single-cell RNA sequencing to investigate cell-type diversity, differentiation, and the evolution of specialized tissues such as striated muscle.</p>
<a href="./projects.html#podocoryna">Explore this research <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="research-card">
<img src="./images/Pocillopora_SanPedro_Morphs.JPG" alt="Different Pocillopora coral forms from the eastern tropical Pacific" />
<div class="research-card-body">
<p class="card-kicker">Biodiversity & conservation</p>
<h3>What diversity is hidden in coral reefs?</h3>
<p>I apply phylogenomics and museum genomics to resolve species boundaries in <em>Pocillopora</em> corals, connecting evolutionary history to coral distributions and conservation.</p>
<a href="./projects.html#coral-diversity">Explore this research <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="research-card">
<img src="./images/Hydroid_hermit.JPG" alt="Research figure from work on coral-associated microbial communities" />
<div class="research-card-body">
<p class="card-kicker">Host–microbe interactions</p>
<h3>How do symbioses shape animal biology?</h3>
<p>My work investigates how coral-associated bacteria and symbiotic algae relate to host physiology, immune responses, and evolutionary diversification.</p>
<a href="./projects.html#host-microbes">Explore this research <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
</div>

<div class="skill-list">
<span>Comparative genomics</span><span>Genome assembly & annotation</span><span>Phylogenomics</span><span>Single-cell RNA-seq</span><span>Transcriptomics</span><span>Host–microbe systems</span><span>Museum genomics</span><span>Bioinformatics workflows</span>

I value collaborative, reproducible research that connects robust computational analyses with biological questions and conservation needs. My work has taken me from molecular laboratories and museum collections to coral reefs in the eastern tropical Pacific.
